**Finding submitted — deviation (fallback target).**

- **What exists:** Section 11.6 is a genuine mutual insurance regime — A.M. Best "A-VII" insurer rating, additional-insured status under the General Liability Policy (p0573), workers' compensation at statutory limits (p0575), employer's liability (p0576), general liability including Clinical Trial Insurance (p0577), and certificates of insurance on request (p0578). AbbVie's self-insurance right (p0579) is favourable to us and left untouched.
- **What fails:** No professional liability (E&O) and no cyber/privacy cover anywhere in the document (searches for both returned nothing), so both fallback elements are unmet.
- **Cure:** One insert after p0577 adding a Harpoon-only limb — E&O USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy USD 2,000,000 — at the fallback threshold only, not the preferred USD 2M/5M figures, and without adding a new coverage burden on AbbVie.
- **Noted, not flagged:** the redacted `[***]` general liability limits should be confirmed at ≥ USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate in diligence.
